page_title: MON 0-0 LIL | Monaco v Lille 18/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Mohamed Bayo (Lille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Eric Wattellier ignores the protests.
90+2' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.

90+1' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Lucas Chevalier guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Caio Henrique walks off the pitch and Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) comes on as a substitute.
87' Alexsandro (Lille) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
84' Here is a change. Ayyoub Bouaddi is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Mohamed Bayo (Lille).
84' A substitution has been made. Edon Zhegrova is replaced by Ngalayel Mukau (Lille).
84' Breel Embolo (Monaco) is adjudged offside.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:1.
81' The referee blows his whistle as Edon Zhegrova (Lille) was too aggressive in his challenge.

80' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Eric Wattellier with no other option than to blow for a foul.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) comes onto the pitch for Eliesse Ben Seghir.
76' The game is interrupted now, Denis Zakaria (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Osame Sahraoui will be replaced by Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille).
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Remy Cabella (Lille) is replacing Angel Gomes.
73' The ball possession at the moment is 57:43.
70' Eric Wattellier shows the yellow card to Osame Sahraoui (Lille) for a heavy challenge.
68' Breel Embolo (Monaco) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
66' Jonathan David (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Takumi Minamino and he is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
63' Here comes a substitution. Breel Embolo (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for George Ilenikhena.
61' Jordan Teze (Monaco) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!

58' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Takumi Minamino (Monaco), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.

56' What a chance that is! Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
56' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' Andre Gomes (Lille) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
54' The foul by George Ilenikhena (Monaco) was seen by Eric Wattellier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
51' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

50' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Takumi Minamino (Monaco). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Monaco earn a corner.
49' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Eric Wattellier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
48' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
46' Jordan Teze (Monaco) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
46' Referee Eric Wattellier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' A quickly taken corner by Monaco.
45+3' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Monaco have a corner.
45+2' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' The foul by Alexsandro (Lille) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Eric Wattellier.
42' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Jordan Teze (Monaco), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
40' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' 60:40 – the latest ball possession ratio.

36' CHANCE! Jordan Teze (Monaco) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
34' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Thomas Meunier (Lille) for a tough tackle.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
31' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Good work from Monaco as they win a corner.
31' Eric Wattellier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Caio Henrique (Monaco).
30' Problems for Bruno Genesio as Mitchel Bakker is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) replaces him.
26' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Caio Henrique (Monaco).

24' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
23' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Eric Wattellier no option but to blow his whistle.
22' Thomas Meunier (Lille) makes a strong challenge and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.

21' What a chance that is! Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
20' Thomas Meunier (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for an infringement.
18' Great teamplay by Monaco as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

16' The ball is laid off to Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Lucas Chevalier to make a decent save.
14' Caio Henrique (Monaco) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Lucas Chevalier to dive and make a save.
11' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) has received a yellow card for his foul.
9' Eric Wattellier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alexsandro (Lille).
7' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

5' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.

3' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Monaco will take the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier was nominated as the referee for this game.
